experiments.notes: v7 fixes live report that /antiafk was not recognized. v6 declared exact-build FrameScript_Execute 0x00704CD0 as __stdcall although the 5875 ABI is __fastcall; current MovementCore already proves the ECX/EDX call shape, and public ClassicAPI reverse engineering agrees. v7 removes native Lua C-function callbacks entirely. FrameScript_Execute installs a pure-Lua SlashCmdList bridge that writes W112_ANTIAFK_CMD, directly seeds hash_SlashCmdList and calls ChatFrame_ImportAllListsToHash when available. The existing UI timer reads commands through proven FrameScript_GetText 0x00703BF0, updates the same Anti-AFK state as GUI, clears the bridge and prints feedback. Registration self-heals every 3s after /reload.
